collection_rule: Retain every positive and negative attempted episode; predeclare any additional nonoverlapping seed cohort before collection. Do not cherry-pick collisions.
selection_rule: Use validation only to select fixed epsilon and PPO checkpoint. One validation event permits exploratory selection, not significance; final precision still requires sufficient independent test events.
comparability: All arms use the same physical P, fixed CAV, initialization and collision event. Single and dual share nearest-actor anchors, observation information and backbone. The dual arm additionally evaluates associated following pairs.
paper_alignment: Report weighted risk, 90% CI, RHW, observed required tests and acceleration. Native 60s highD results are not a literal replication of the paper's 400m SUMO experiment or its 2100x number.
